def _parse_timestamp(value: Any) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)): return float(value)
    try:
       text = str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00")
       dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
       if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
       return dt.timestamp()
    except Exception:

    normalized.setdefault("timestamp", _now_iso())
    normalized.setdefault("source", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("event_type", "generic")
    normalized.setdefault("severity", "low")
    normalized.setdefault("user", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("ip", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("action", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("status", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("details", {})

    normalized["severity"] = severity if severity in SEVERITY_SCORES else "low"
    event_type = str(normalized.get("event_type", "generic")).lower()
    normalized["event_type"] = event_type
    status = str(normalized.get("status", "unknown")).lower()
    normalized["status"] = status
    normalized["user"] = str(normalized.get("user", "unknown"))
    normalized["ip"] = str(normalized.get("ip", "unknown"))
    normalized["action"] = str(normalized.get("action", "unknown"))
    normalized["source"] = str(normalized.get("source", "unknown"))
    return normalized

    logger.addHandler(_handler)
logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

SEVERITY_SCORES = {"low": 1, "medium": 2, "high": 3, "critical": 4}
AUTH_EVENT_TYPES = {"auth", "authentication", "login", "logout", "session", "access", "authorization"}
FAILURE_STATUSES = {"failure", "failed", "denied", "unauthorized", "error", "blocked"}
SUSPICIOUS_EVENT_TYPES = {"malware", "intrusion", "privilege_escalation", "data_exfiltration", "config_change", "system", "network", "file"}

def _now_iso(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def _parse_timestamp(value: Any) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)): return float(value)
    try:
       text = str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00")
       dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
       if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
       return dt.timestamp()
    except Exception:
       return time.time()

def normalize_event(event: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(event, dict): event = {"message": str(event)}
    normalized = dict(event)
    normalized.setdefault("event_id", str(uuid.uuid4()))
    normalized.setdefault("timestamp", _now_iso())
    normalized.setdefault("source", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("event_type", "generic")
    normalized.setdefault("severity", "low")
    normalized.setdefault("user", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("ip", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("action", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("status", "unknown")
    normalized.setdefault("details", {})
    severity = str(normalized.get("severity", "low")).lower()
    normalized["severity"] = severity if severity in SEVERITY_SCORES else "low"
    event_type = str(normalized.get("event_type", "generic")).lower()
    normalized["event_type"] = event_type
    status = str(normalized.get("status", "unknown")).lower()
    normalized["status"] = status
    normalized["user"] = str(normalized.get("user", "unknown"))
    normalized["ip"] = str(normalized.get("ip", "unknown"))
    normalized["action"] = str(normalized.get("action", "unknown"))
    normalized["source"] = str(normalized.get("source", "unknown"))
    return normalized

def make_alert(kind, event, message, metadata=None):
    return {"alert_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "timestamp": _now_iso(), "kind": kind, "message": message, "severity": event.get("severity", "high"), "event_id": event.get("event_id"), "event_type": event.get("event_type"), "user": event.get("user"), "ip": event.get("ip"), "metadata": metadata or {}}
